fields.description: Event creation time as an RFC3339 timestamp with nanosecond precision, normalized to UTC.
fields.name: timestamp

fields.description: Operational severity; one of debug, info, warn, error, or critical.
fields.name: level

fields.description: Stable snake_case event name used for grouping, search, and automation.
fields.name: event

fields.description: Product service or client component that emitted the event.
fields.name: service

fields.description: Runtime environment in which the event was emitted.
fields.name: environment

fields.description: Build or release version of the emitting component.
fields.name: build_version

fields.description: Observability event schema version; the permanent contract currently defines version 1.
fields.name: schema_version

fields.description: Stable subsystem category used for filtering and category-level log controls.
fields.name: category

fields.description: Human-readable context; tooling must use event rather than parsing this text.
fields.name: message

fields.description: Unique identifier for this event; newly created values must use UUID format.
fields.name: event_id

fields.description: UUID correlating one distributed operation or investigation chain.
fields.name: trace_id

fields.description: Existing domain-owned identifier for an API or HTTP request.
fields.name: request_id

fields.description: Existing domain-owned identifier for a gameplay or service session.
fields.name: session_id

fields.description: Existing domain-owned identifier for a room flow.
fields.name: room_id

fields.description: Existing domain-owned identifier for a match or match-result flow.
fields.name: match_id

fields.description: Readable player-facing identifier, such as Player-1; do not replace it with a UUID for observability.
fields.name: player_id

fields.description: Existing domain-owned identifier for an account when account context is relevant.
fields.name: account_id

fields.description: API, HTTP, or logical route associated with the event; exclude credentials and raw secrets.
fields.name: route

fields.description: Packet type associated with a network event, without including the packet payload.
fields.name: packet_type

fields.description: Stable machine-readable error code.
fields.name: error_code

fields.description: Categorized reason or mode for an observed failure.
fields.name: failure_mode

fields.description: Bounded duration measurement in milliseconds for the operation summarized by the event.
fields.name: duration_ms

fields.description: Named degraded, offline, maintenance, or admission-blocked state.
fields.name: degraded_state

fields.description: Bounded opaque key used to correlate retries and suppress duplicate effects; never include secrets.
fields.name: idempotency_key

fields.description: UUID identifying a diagnostic report or bundle.
fields.name: diagnostic_report_id

fields.description: UUID reference for an audit-grade record, when one is created.
fields.name: audit_event_id

fields.description: Existing domain-owned identifier for the actor responsible for an audit-worthy action.
fields.name: actor_id

fields.description: Category of actor, such as player, service, admin, or system.
fields.name: actor_type

fields.description: Existing domain-owned identifier for the target of an audit-worthy action.
fields.name: target_id

fields.description: Category of target affected by an audit-worthy action.
fields.name: target_type

fields.description: Stable action name for an audit-worthy state change.
fields.name: action

fields.description: Stable non-sensitive reason code for an action or decision.
fields.name: reason_code

fields.description: UUID identifying a support, moderation, dispute, or administrative case.
fields.name: case_id

fields.description: UUID identifying a transaction or entitlement operation without exposing payment data.
fields.name: transaction_id

fields.description: Existing domain-owned identifier for a competitive or persisted match result.
fields.name: result_id

fields.description: When true, the aggregator validates, preserves, and promotes the event into an audit-grade record.
fields.name: audit_required

fields.description: Domain-defined audit classification used when audit_required is true.
fields.name: audit_type

fields.description: UUID identifying the running service instance that emitted the event.
fields.name: service_instance_id

fields.description: Worker name or index for the worker or job execution that emitted the event.
fields.name: worker_id

fields.description: Operating-system process identifier for local diagnostics.
fields.name: pid

fields.description: UUID assigned to an ingestion request or batch by the receiving aggregator.
fields.name: ingestion_id

fields.description: RFC3339-nanosecond UTC time at which the aggregator accepted the event.
fields.name: ingested_at

fields.description: Named source or transport from which the aggregator received the event.
fields.name: ingestion_source

fields.description: Positive bounded attempt number for delivery or retry ingestion.
fields.name: ingestion_attempt

fields.description: Indicates that one or more unsafe or sensitive values were removed or transformed before storage or export.
fields.name: redaction_applied

fields.description: Retention classification: ephemeral_dev, operational, diagnostic_report, or audit_grade.
fields.name: retention_tier

fields.description: Bounded event-specific key/value data; keys and scalar values must obey schema limits and redaction rules.
fields.name: fields

actions.description: Reject the event, field, or bundle when unsafe content cannot be safely removed.
actions.name: reject

actions.description: Remove the unsafe value and retain only the safe replacement marker.
actions.name: redact

tiers.name: ephemeral_dev
tiers.purpose: Local development and temporary subsystem debugging.

tiers.name: operational
tiers.purpose: Routine operational diagnosis and cross-service event investigation.

tiers.name: diagnostic_report
tiers.purpose: User- or tester-facing bug reports, copy diagnostics, and bounded diagnostic bundles.

tiers.name: audit_grade
tiers.purpose: Audit-worthy aggregated records created by an explicit audit trigger.
